title: Topology
description: Operator-private deployment topology consumed by the `eidan deploy` CLI. One node per host the operator runs an eidan backend on (Pi, Fly machine, Docker container, …). Reconcilers walk this document and bring each node into the declared state — render env files, install bundles, restart services. Lives at `.eidan/topology.yml` by default; overridable via `--topology=<path>` so a private ops repo can hold it. Secrets carried as plain strings (post-decryption); the CLI accepts ansible-vault per-value tags transparently in a follow-up.

schema.description: Topology schema version. Always 1 for this shape; bumped on breaking changes per `docs/004 §9`.

defaults.description: Repo-wide defaults applied per-node via deep-merge. Per-node values override. Lets the operator declare `plugin_source: gh:sielay` and the GitHub PAT once for every node instead of repeating them.

nodes.description: Map of node-name → node config. Node names are operator-chosen and used by `eidan deploy --node <name>`, log lines, and the per-node telemetry view in the admin UI (`docs/024`). Each node reconciles independently; failure on one does not block the others. A zero-node topology is rejected at the parser level (`load_topology`) rather than in this schema — `minProperties: 1` codegens inconsistently across `datamodel-code-generator` versions, so the constraint lives in `apps/cli/eidan_cli/topology.py` for portability.

plugin_source.description: Default `EIDAN_PLUGIN_SOURCE` for plugin install on each node. Typically `gh:<org>` so the CLI clones private bundle repos from GitHub. Per-node `plugin_source` wins.

github_token.description: GitHub PAT with `repo:read` on the private bundle repos. Vault-encrypt in the YAML; the CLI exports it to target nodes only during install and never persists it on the target filesystem (see `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md §3.11`). Per-node override possible if different nodes pull from different orgs.

provider.description: Default LLM provider config. Per-node `provider:` wins. Lets the operator say `everywhere uses anthropic` while a single Pi node overrides to `ollama` for local inference.

sentry.description: Default Sentry plugin config. Per-node `sentry:` wins. Typical pattern: enabled on the Pi, disabled on Fly (cf. DEPLOYMENT.md §4.4).

smtp.description: Default SMTP config for magic-link delivery. Per-node `smtp:` wins. Often identical across nodes since all share one Postgres + one operator email.

log_forward.description: Default log-forwarding config (BetterStack / Datadog / Axiom / Loki). Per-node `log_forward:` wins. Typical pattern: all nodes ship to one intake.

image.description: Default container image for image-based targets (`fly`, future `docker`). Per-node `image:` wins. Typical pattern: pin a specific tag here so all Fly machines roll forward together; leave unset to build from the local Dockerfile.

target.description: Reconciler that owns this node. `pi` drives the Ansible playbook under `infra/pi/`; `fly` drives flyctl; `docker` drives docker compose (recipe TBD).

database_url.description: asyncpg-style URL the backend connects to. `postgresql+asyncpg://...`. Vault-encrypt in the YAML.

auth_master_key.description: Byte-identical value of `EIDAN_AUTH_MASTER_KEY` for every node that joins this Postgres (DEPLOYMENT.md §3.6). Vault-encrypt in the YAML. Generate once with `python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))'`.

auth_allowed_email.description: Single email the magic-link endpoint mints links for. Unset means refuse-all.

deployment_mode.description: Switches the refresh cookie to `Secure` + suppresses the dev link echo. Default `production` matches what every real deploy wants.

http_host.description: `EIDAN_HTTP_HOST`. `0.0.0.0` for nodes that serve the frontend directly; `127.0.0.1` for nodes behind a reverse proxy on the same box; the loopback default is rarely right on a Pi.

cors_origins.description: `EIDAN_HTTP_CORS_ORIGINS` as a list — the reconciler joins on commas. The frontend host(s) that talk to this backend. Empty list / unset = no cross-origin allowance.

provider.description: Per-node LLM provider override. Wins over `defaults.provider`.

bundles.description: Bundles to install on this node. Idempotent on bundle name — adding installs, removing does NOT uninstall (use `eidan admin plugin sync --prune` on the box). Each bundle slug matches a GitHub repo under `plugin_source`.

disable.description: Plugin names to disable on this node via `EIDAN_DISABLED_PLUGINS`. The plugin is installed but the loader skips it — no on_install, on_activate, behaviours, routers, or MCP tools. See `docs/001 §8.2`.

extra_env.description: Per-node environment passthrough for plugin env vars not modelled as typed Node fields. Keys must match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` (e.g. `EIDAN_GIT_STACKS`, `EIDAN_SAGE_LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS`). Values land verbatim in `/etc/eidan/eidan.env` (pi) or `[env]` in `fly.toml` (fly). Vault-encrypt entries that carry secrets.

plugin_source.description: Per-node `EIDAN_PLUGIN_SOURCE` override. Rare — most operators set this in `defaults`.

github_token.description: Per-node GitHub PAT override. Rare — most operators set this in `defaults`. Vault-encrypt.

node_id.description: Optional pinned `EIDAN_NODE_ID` for telemetry. Auto-detected from `FLY_MACHINE_ID` / `DYNO` / hostname when unset. Pin when one host runs multiple eidan processes so their heartbeats don't trample each other (`docs/024 §3`).

node_type.description: Optional `EIDAN_NODE_TYPE` for the admin UI dashboard grouping. Typical values: `pi`, `fly`, `docker`, `laptop`.

sentry.description: Per-node Sentry config override. Wins over `defaults.sentry`. Typical: disable on Fly auto-stop machines, enable on the Pi.

log_forward.description: Per-node log-forwarding override (BetterStack / Datadog / Axiom / Loki). Wins over `defaults.log_forward`.

ollama_base_url.description: Override the Ollama base URL when `provider.name = ollama`. Defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` — pin only when Ollama runs on a different host or non-default port.

image.description: Container image reference for image-based targets (`fly`, future `docker`). Pin a specific tag — e.g. `ghcr.io/sielay/eidan:v0.1.0` — to skip the local Dockerfile build entirely. Ignored for `target: pi` (Ansible installs from git). When UNSET, the Fly reconciler builds from `infra/fly/Dockerfile` in the operator's eidan checkout (cwd or `EIDAN_SOURCE_DIR`). Digests (`...@sha256:...`) are accepted; the reconciler passes the value through to `fly deploy --image` verbatim.

host.description: PI ONLY — hostname or IP for ssh. Required when `target: pi`. Ignored for other targets.

ssh_user.description: PI ONLY — SSH login on the Pi (typically your admin user, not the `eidan` service user). Required when `target: pi`. Ignored for other targets.

ssh_key.description: PI ONLY — path to the SSH private key. Tilde-expanded by the reconciler. Optional; defaults to ssh-agent / default identity discovery if unset.

app.description: FLY ONLY — `fly.toml` `app` name. Required when `target: fly`. Ignored for other targets.

region.description: FLY ONLY — Fly primary region (3-letter code like `lhr`, `iad`). Required when `target: fly`. Ignored for other targets.

compose_project.description: DOCKER ONLY — `docker compose -p <name>` project label. Required when `target: docker`. Ignored for other targets.

api_key.description: API key for the chosen provider. Vault-encrypt. Ignored for `ollama` (which has no API key). Maps to the provider-specific env var (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` / etc.) on the target node.

enabled.description: `EIDAN_SENTRY_ENABLED`. Default `true`; pin to `false` on nodes that auto-stop (the 5-minute tick would prevent idle scale-down).

tick_interval.description: ISO 8601 duration for the Sentry tick (`EIDAN_SENTRY_TICK_INTERVAL`). Default 5 minutes.

model.description: `EIDAN_SENTRY_MODEL`. Currently a configured-but-unused slot until the local-model adapter ships (DEPLOYMENT.md §3.10).

from.description: `EIDAN_SMTP_FROM` — the From: header on outbound mail.

url.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_URL`. Intake endpoint (BetterStack: `https://in.logs.betterstack.com`; Datadog: `https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs`; Axiom: `https://api.axiom.co/v1/datasets/<name>/ingest`; Loki: through a Vector/Fluent Bit relay). Forwarder is off when this is unset on every node + defaults.

token.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_TOKEN`. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — BetterStack source token, Axiom API key, Honeycomb write key. Vault-encrypt. Mutually exclusive with `headers:` (the operator picks one auth shape); both unset means no auth header (rare — only for self-hosted unauthed intakes).

headers.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_HEADERS`. JSON-encoded map of extra headers. Escape hatch for non-Bearer auth (Datadog's `DD-API-KEY`, custom routing headers). Vault-encrypt values that carry credentials.

level.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_LEVEL`. Minimum level the forwarder accepts; default `INFO`. Effective threshold is `max(root_logger_level, this)`. Set `WARNING` to keep the intake quieter.

timeout.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_TIMEOUT`. HTTP POST timeout in seconds; default `5.0`. Failures are swallowed; the next log line retries.

queue_size.description: `EIDAN_LOG_FORWARD_QUEUE_SIZE`. Max in-process buffer size; default `10000`. When the intake stalls, records past this cap are dropped (with a stderr warning).
